favourableRunSelection.rule: Under nondeterminism BOTH runs are preserved in full. Neither is designated canonical, and no downstream artifact may silently prefer one.

requiresAll: primary and repeat evidence match exactly at every SEMANTIC comparison level

acquisitionVerdicts.when: evidence is complete and truth-isolated, but one or more primary/repeat records differ at a SEMANTIC comparison level
acquisitionVerdicts.notTriggeredBy: a difference confined to timings or run metadata

acquisitionVerdicts.when: a required field, case, candidate or OCR record is missing or truncated
truth or expected outcomes entered acquisition before the raw freeze
the fixed acquisition could not complete

fullArtifactIntegrity.covers: every persisted byte of every raw file and manifest, INCLUDING timings and run metadata
fullArtifactIntegrity.computedAs: sha256 over the file bytes, plus an aggregate over the sorted manifest lines
fullArtifactIntegrity.why: Two runs legitimately differ in timings and run metadata. An integrity hash that matched across runs would mean the second run had not been recorded independently.

semanticOrderedPassArrayFingerprint.computedOver: the complete ordered pass array after removing timings from each pass
semanticOrderedPassArrayFingerprint.why: Production selects over the pass array in order; a reordered replay is a different experiment.

excludedFromTheSemanticEqualityGate.why: These are provenance and telemetry, not OCR output. A difference in any of them says nothing about whether the recognizer produced the same result.
excludedFromTheSemanticEqualityGate.butNeverAloneAVerdict: A difference confined to timings or run metadata must NOT produce COMPLETE_WITH_NONDETERMINISM. It is reported descriptively.

cropPixelComparisonRemoved: The 'crop pixels' level compared cropPixelSha256 per pass. That value is not obtainable through the frozen production interface; see raw-ocr-contract.json#unavailableThroughTheFrozenInterface.
